title: Moza AB6 MSFS 2024 Setup: P-51 Mustang FFB Tuning & Master Layout Guide
description:
Dial in your Moza AB6 direct drive base for the North American P-51 Mustang in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

At high speeds just 30 feet off the desert floor, pulling heavy Gs around racing pylons causes stall speeds to skyrocket past 230 knots. Standard centering springs offer zero warning before an unrecoverable snap roll. In this kickoff guide, we break down essential pylon aerodynamics ("bank before you pull"), establish our universal master controller layout, calibrate Moza Cockpit force feedback telemetry to transmit the aerodynamic stall buffet before flow separation, and solve broken fuel booster toggles using MobiFlight Connector.

Want to skip manual slider adjustments? Download the ready-to-import profiles on the website:
🔗 Download FFB & Control Profiles: https://highintheflightsimsky.nl
